mass-0.title: 2017 Las Vegas shooting (Route 91 Harvest festival)
mass-0.place: Las Vegas Village / Mandalay Bay, Las Vegas, Nevada, USA
mass-0.summary: On October 1, 2017 a gunman fired more than 1,000 rounds from the 32nd floor of the Mandalay Bay into the Route 91 Harvest music festival crowd, killing 60 people (including two who died later) and injuring hundreds. He died by suicide before police entered. Both the LVMPD and the FBI concluded he acted alone and that no clear motive could be determined.
evidence: LVMPD Force Investigation Team final report (Aug 2018): 2,000 leads, 22,000 hours of video, 252,000 images reviewed.
FBI Behavioral Analysis Unit review panel key findings (Jan 2019).
Weapons and ammunition were purchased legally (LVMPD).

sources.label: FBI BAU Las Vegas Review Panel, Key Findings (Jan 2019)
AP via NBC: "No motive, no 2nd shooter" (Aug 2018)

mass-0.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Official findings: motive undetermined
Investigation closed without a determined motive
Documented open questions (3) from official/reputable sources

questions.text: No single or clear motivating factor was found; no manifesto, note or explanatory communication.

source.label: FBI BAU Las Vegas Review Panel, Key Findings (Jan 2019)

questions.text: LVMPD: "this report will not be able to address the why"; investigators were "unable to uncover or discover what Paddock’s motive may have been."
Investigators could not determine whether earlier reservations overlooking other open-air festivals were for planning or an intended attack.

rumors.text: Some eyewitnesses said shots seemed to come from different angles, a lower floor (often cited: the 4th floor of Mandalay Bay), or a second shooter. A widely shared video of flashes on a lower floor drove the theory.

source.label: ABC7: false rumor of second shooter on fourth floor (Oct 2017)

rumors.finding: LVMPD final report, Investigative Finding 1: "Paddock acted alone. Despite early reports of multiple shooters in different locations, no evidence exists to substantiate any of those reports." The FBI panel likewise concluded he "conspired with no one; he acted alone." Fact-checkers noted no 4th-floor windows were broken and the same flashing light appears in video from before the shooting. The report also notes that echoes made a detective on scene think it "could be from multiple shooters."

finding_source.label: FBI BAU Las Vegas Review Panel, Key Findings (Jan 2019)

rumors.text: During the attack, people across the Strip reported gunfire or active shooters at other properties (e.g. New York-New York, Tropicana, Bellagio) and the airport, and some later felt these reports were scrubbed.

source.label: Las Vegas Review-Journal live report, Oct 1 2017 (archived)

rumors.finding: The reports were real reports, but no other shootings occurred: LVMPD officers spent the night clearing other casinos for "possible additional shooters" and the final report found no evidence to substantiate them. The Clark County fire chief attributed the erroneous reports to injured concertgoers fleeing into nearby casinos.

finding_source.label: Review-Journal: fire radio traffic and false reports

rumors.text: Online videos claimed "black helicopters" were present, or that helicopters fired on the crowd.

source.label: Wikipedia: 2017 Las Vegas shooting conspiracy theories

rumors.finding: Unresolved / no official response found addressing helicopters specifically. The LVMPD and FBI general findings are that the gunman acted alone and that no evidence substantiated reports of other shooters. News helicopters filmed the hotel afterwards (ABC News aerial footage, Oct 2).

rumors.text: Claims of unusual planes or activity at McCarran (now Harry Reid) International Airport during the attack, and reports of shots at the airport.

source.label: Review-Journal: erroneous reports of shots inside McCarran

rumors.finding: Documented fact: the LVMPD timeline records the gunman firing about eight rounds at airport fuel tanks (two struck a tank) from his room. Reports of shots inside the airport were among the erroneous reports that night. No official finding of other airport-related involvement was found.

rumors.text: Claims that released police body-camera footage and the official timeline do not line up.

source.label: Reuters: new timeline raises questions on police response (Oct 2017)

rumors.finding: The timeline was revised publicly in the first weeks (a hotel security officer was shot before, not after, the gunfire on the crowd began). Body-camera footage was released in May 2018 after a Nevada Supreme Court ruling. The final LVMPD report reconstructs the timeline from body-worn cameras and video, notes where a witness statement was contradicted, and documents an officer’s unintentional discharge after the breach. It reports no evidence of anyone else involved.

mass-1.title: Chicago Tylenol murders
mass-1.summary: Seven people died after taking Extra-Strength Tylenol capsules laced with potassium cyanide. The case led to tamper-evident packaging laws. No one has been charged with the murders.
evidence: Investigators concluded tampering occurred at retail level, not the factory.

mass-4.title: University of Texas tower shooting
mass-4.place: University of Texas, Austin, Texas, USA
mass-4.summary: A gunman killed his mother and wife, then 14 people from the UT Tower (a 17th victim died in 2001). An autopsy found a brain tumor; a governor’s commission could not determine whether it contributed.
